title: Tall Tailz Charters
specs: 36' Osmond Beal built H and H Downeast style charter boat with enclosed cabin and toilet
Captain Connor MacLeod is USCG licensed with 100 ton masters near coastal and advanced certifications
Up to 6 passengers per trip, sometimes only 4 for nearshore and tuna trips
No experience necessary; guided and taught on board
includes: All fishing equipment, bait, tackle, safety and emergency gear, ice and bottled water

addons.name: If marine fuel prices are over

blurb: Guests fish for various species including lobster, bottom fish, tautog, tuna, sharks, and pelagic species on a 36' Osmond Beal built H and H Downeast style charter boat. Trips range from nearshore to offshore canyons with durations from 2.5 hours to 36 hours. The captain is USCG licensed and prioritizes safety and customer experience.
extraNote: 20% deposit required to reserve a trip · 10% discount for active duty military and veterans · 48 hour cancellation notice required or deposit forfeited · Trips fish rain or shine; only high winds cancel trips · Deposits for offshore and nearshore tuna/shark trips are non-refundable but transferable or reschedulable · Overly intoxicated passengers will be removed with no refund; glass bottles not allowed · April through December
